headline: 藝穗節開了三溫暖劇場
context: 愛丁堡藝穗節出現英國第一座「三溫暖劇場」：由 Studio Three Sixty 打造、可容納約 80 人的功能性三溫暖，觀眾穿著泳裝流著汗看戲，把桑拿儀式和劇場、音樂、說書揉在一起。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The 80-seat venue at Edinburgh fringe combines sauna rituals with theatre, music, storytelling … and sweat Tucked away behind the Summerhall arts centre is the hottest new venue at the Edinburgh fringe … quite literally. The Sauna theatre has proved popular among theatregoers at the world’s largest performing arts festival, with shows inside its purpose-built, 80-seat sauna drawing sweaty, swimwear-clad crowds. Visitors may be forgiven for thinking the sauna is a gimmick, especially at the fringe where absurd, experimental and ludicrous performances are not uncommon. This year they include a man drinking his own urine , someone singing the same song over and over , physical feats of exertion and several fully naked shows. Continue reading...
sources.title: Hot ticket: UK’s first sauna theatre draws swimwear-clad audiences

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Design practice Studio Three Sixty has created a temporary sauna that is being used as a theatre during Edinburgh's Fringe festival for the performing arts. Designed by Studio Three Sixty director Lucy Osborne, who is also co-creative director of Sauna Sessions Arts Club, the functioning sauna can seat up to 82 people for performances. thread_text:
愛丁堡藝穗節最熱的場地，是字面意義上的熱——英國第一座三溫暖劇場（Sauna Theatre）。這座由 Studio Three Sixty 的 Lucy Osborne 設計、藏在 Summerhall 藝術中心後方的臨時場館，是一座真的能運作的三溫暖，可容納約 80 名觀眾，穿泳裝、流著汗，看劇場、音樂和說書輪番上演。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 Dezeen 於 2026 年 8 月 27 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
愛丁堡藝穗節最熱門的新場地，熱是字面意義的——英國第一座三溫暖劇場（Sauna Theatre）。它藏在 Summerhall 藝術中心後方，由 Studio Three Sixty 的 Lucy Osborne 設計，是一座真的能運作的三溫暖，可容納約 80 名觀眾。大家穿著泳裝、流著汗，看劇場、聽音樂、聽說書——把桑拿的儀式感和表演揉在一起。在什麼荒誕實驗都有的藝穗節，你可能以為這是噱頭；但票房證明，觀眾是真的買單。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 Dezeen 於 2026 年 8 月 27 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
